responsibility: This file implements the main OpenMP/OpenACC lowering pass that converts high-level GIMPLE_OMP constructs into lower-level GIMPLE suitable for final expansion. It builds and traverses omp_context trees for nested constructs, rewrites variable references according to private/firstprivate/shared/reduction/lastprivate/allocate semantics, creates and populates data-sharing records for outlined regions and tasks, lowers cancellation, reductions, scans, target and worksharing constructs, and regimplifies the transformed code. It also contains the structured-block diagnostic pass that validates illegal branches into or out of OpenMP/OpenACC structured regions before or during lowering.
same_name_distinction: Contains the actual lowering machinery behind gcc/omp-low.h: it defines the internal omp_context representation and performs the full traversal that rewrites GIMPLE_OMP constructs, data-sharing, reductions, and structured-block diagnostics. Unlike gcc/omp-low.h, which exports only a few helper declarations, this file owns the main lowering pass implementation.
